About

Computer Security Research is where we post our own occasional previews of work on the security and privacy of computer systems: threat modeling, operating-system and platform security, cryptographic engineering, forensics, and the verifiability of devices and software.

These are our own writings, posted infrequently and for public commentary only.

The analysis here aims to be rigorous and vendor-neutral, grounded in the published technical literature. Each piece states its threat model and scope explicitly and distinguishes claims supported by cited evidence from claims that remain asserted.
